d: Bihar ke simanchal kshetr ki rajniti men demographi badlav aur votar list sudhar (SIR) ka mudda ek bar phir garma gaya hai. purniya ke aitihasik jila skul maidan se aaraen sah chauk tak aayojit bhartiy janta parti ki vishal 'loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao' padyatra men shamil hone pahunche asam ke mukhyamantri himant bisva sarma ne vipaksh aur rahul gandhi par tikha hamla bola. rahul gandhi dvara lagae ja rahe 'vot chori' ke aaropon ka javab dete hue himant bisva sarma ne tanj kasa ki sachin tendulkar ne shatkon ka rikord banaya hai, jabki rahul gandhi ne chunav harne ka shatak banaya hai…
